offerings.name: Google Search API (SERP API)
offerings.pricing: Top-up model, no monthly subscriptions. Starter $50 (50k credits, $1.00/1k); Standard $375 (500k credits, $0.75/1k); Scale $1250 (2.5M credits, $0.50/1k); Ultimate $3750 (12.5M credits, $0.30/1k). Excluding sales tax/VAT/GST.
offerings.price_basis: Starter（最低公开档，$50/50k credits，每 credit 一次查询）
offerings.free_quota: Get 2,500 free queries / Try 2,500 queries for free（No credit card required）
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（JSON，含 organic、knowledgeGraph、peopleAlsoAsk、relatedSearches 等）；另提供 Images、News、Maps、Places、Videos、Shopping、Scholar、Patents、Autocomplete 等端点
offerings.note: Real-time results，无缓存；返回 1-2 秒（个别 2-4s）；可自定义查询国家/语言；credits 有效期 6 个月；费率限制 Starter 50 QPS 至 Ultimate 300 QPS；价格高至约 $0.30/1k（Ultimate）。
